scripts.build:native:darwin:local: yarn build:native:darwin && mkdir -p dist/native/darwin && cp native/macos-permissions/build/Release/permissions.node dist/native/darwin/permissions.node
scripts.build:native:linux:local: yarn build:native:linux && mkdir -p dist/native/linux/$(node -p process.arch) && cp native/linux-serial-control/build/Release/serial_control.node dist/native/linux/$(node -p process.arch)/serial_control.node
scripts.wasm-build: cd rust_wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../wasm-node && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('../wasm-node/.gitignore',{force:true})"
scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const files=['wasm-node/wl_lvgl_wasm.js','wasm-node/wl_lvgl_wasm_bg.wasm'];const missing=files.filter((file)=>!fs.existsSync(file)||fs.statSync(file).size===0);if(missing.length)throw new Error('Cannot package @worklouder/wl-device-kit: missing generated WASM artifact(s): '+missing.join(', ')+'. Run yarn wasm-build first.');fs.rmSync('wasm-node/.gitignore',{force:true});"
